factors.fitting_context_initial: Independent default-OFF cold-start context only; requires both strict modes and four-stage.
factors.selector_importance_cache: Independent default-OFF per-leaf selector computation reuse; not pretrained data/teacher augmentation.

scope_limit: Initial fitting packet only. Existing later feedback still contains prior outer outcomes; no whole-feedback fitting-only claim.

cache_limits.lifetime: one actual leaf worker; scopes/views/calibration separated
cache_limits.retained: importance vector+column metadata only; no X/y/models/predictions

scientific_A_B: Do not confound factors: context-only and cache-only hypotheses must retain separate flags/control conditions and measured receipts. This package grants no API/ML experiment.
